from solution import find_substring


def test_issue_example_ack():
    """Check if a substring is present in a given list per example."""
    # 0 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 0 = 1 > 0 => True
    assert find_substring(["red", "black", "white", "green", "orange"], "ack") == True


def test_issue_prefix_match():
    """Check if a substring at start of an element counts as present."""
    # 1 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 = 1 > 0 => True
    assert find_substring(["red", "black", "white", "green", "orange"], "re") == True


def test_issue_full_element_match():
    """Check if a substring equal to a whole element counts as present."""
    # 1 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 = 1 > 0 => True
    assert find_substring(["red", "black", "white", "green", "orange"], "red") == True


def test_issue_no_match():
    """Check if absent substring in list returns False."""
    # 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 = 0 => False
    assert find_substring(["red", "black", "white", "green", "orange"], "zzz") == False


def test_issue_match_only_last_element():
    """Check if a substring present only in last element is found."""
    # 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 1 = 1 > 0 => True
    assert find_substring(["red", "black", "white", "green", "orange"], "range") == True


def test_issue_single_element_match():
    """Check if a substring is present in a single-element list."""
    # 1 = 1 > 0 => True
    assert find_substring(["hello"], "ell") == True


def test_issue_empty_list():
    """Check if empty list returns False for any substring."""
    # sum over 0 elements = 0 => False
    assert find_substring([], "ack") == False


def test_issue_longer_than_any_element():
    """Check if substring longer than every element returns False."""
    # 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 = 0 => False
    assert find_substring(["red", "black", "white", "green", "orange"], "blackwhite") == False


def test_contract_returns_true_for_present():
    """Function returns True when substring is present in list values."""
    # 0 + 1 = 1 > 0 => True
    result = find_substring(["abc", "def"], "bc")
    assert result == True


def test_contract_returns_false_for_absent():
    """Function returns False when substring is absent from list values."""
    # 0 + 0 = 0 => False
    result = find_substring(["abc", "def"], "xyz")
    assert result == False
